description: This file defines the interface 'UccParser' within the 'beerocks' namespace, which models a parser for UCC command strings received over sockets. It includes documentation on how implementations should parse command strings from byte buffers and handle different socket types and message formats.

classes.name: UccParser
classes.description: An interface for parsing UCC command strings from byte buffers, designed to be implemented differently depending on socket and protocol specifics.

methods.name: parse_command
methods.description: Parses a UCC command string out of a byte buffer; returns true if successful and false otherwise.
